metadata.question: Does the vegetation coverage in the Inner Niger Delta increase in November 2022 compared to May 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for vegetation monitoring) - Location: Inner Niger Delta (need to define a polygon for this region) - Dates: May 2022 (2022-05-01 to 2022-05-31) and November 2022 (2022-11-01 to 2022-11-30) - Band: NDVI for vegetation analysis 2. Masking Strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get valid vegetation data - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for both time periods - Compare if November NDVI > May NDVI - Check for valid data and pixels Let me define the Inner Niger Delta region and implement the analysis. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Inner Niger Delta region (approximate bounds) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-5.5, 14.0], [-4.0, 14.0], [-4.0, 15.5], [-5.5, 15.5], [-5.5, 14.0]] ]); // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Get May 2022 data const may2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('2022-05-01', '2022-05-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2Clouds) .map(addNDVI); // Get November 2022 data const nov2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('2022-11-01', '2022-11-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2Clouds) .map(addNDVI); // Check collection sizes const maySize = may2022.size().getInfo(); const novSize = nov2022.size().getInfo(); print(`May 2022 Images: ${maySize}`); print(`November 2022 Images: ${novSize}`); if (maySize === 0 || novSize === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Create median composites and calculate mean NDVI const mayComposite = may2022.median().select('NDVI'); const novComposite = nov2022.median().select('NDVI'); // Calculate mean NDVI values const mayStats = mayComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const novStats = novComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mayNDVI = mayStats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const novNDVI = novStats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const mayCount = mayComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const novCount = novComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); print(`May 2022 NDVI: ${mayNDVI ? mayNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Pixels: ${mayCount}`); print(`Nov 2022 NDVI: ${novNDVI ? novNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Pixels: ${novCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (mayCount === 0 || novCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mayNDVI === null || novNDVI === null || isNaN(mayNDVI) || isNaN(novNDVI) || mayNDVI > 1 || mayNDVI < -1 || novNDVI > 1 || novNDVI < -1) { print("C3"); return; } // Determine answer based on NDVI comparison if (novNDVI > mayNDVI) { print(`Vegetation increased: ${novNDVI.toFixed(3)} > ${mayNDVI.toFixed(3)}`); print("A"); } else { print(`Vegetation decreased: ${novNDVI.toFixed(3)} <= ${mayNDVI.toFixed(3)}`); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
